description: Runs any utility tool from this page, without opening the utility: `name` from catalog_get_utility, `input` matching the schema from catalog_describe_tool. Returns the tool's own result (locale-neutral data) or a structured error; for a tool with a deep link, the result includes `url`, a link to the answer on the tool page in this language, to give the person. Read-only; the call is shown on the page.
name: catalog_run_tool
title: Run a tool
